types.description: Reports bicycles, scooters, or motorcycles left unattended in public right‑of‑way.
phrasings: A bike has been sitting on the sidewalk for weeks.
There’s an abandoned scooter blocking the bike lane.
A motorcycle is parked illegally on the street curb.
Someone left a bike chain on the trail, looks abandoned.
types.crew_needs: Exact location, description of the vehicle, and a photo if possible.

types.description: Report of a vacant structure that appears neglected, unsafe, or a public nuisance.
phrasings: There's an empty building that's falling apart.
Abandoned house on my block is a hazard.
A vacant property is covered in graffiti and trash.
The old building looks unsafe and unused.
types.crew_needs: Property address or nearest cross‑streets and any visible safety concerns (photo optional).

types.description: Reports vehicles that have been left unattended for an extended period.
phrasings: A scooter has been sitting on the curb for weeks
Abandoned motorcycle blocking the driveway
Multiple cars parked in the lot for months
RV left on the street with no owner
types.crew_needs: Location (street address or lot) and, if possible, the license plate number.

types.description: Covers dead or stray animal removal and related ground‑maintenance issues.
phrasings: There's a dead raccoon on the sidewalk.
Can someone pick up a dead squirrel in the park?
We have a stray dog hanging around the lot.
Dead bird on the grass needs to be removed.
types.crew_needs: Exact location (street and nearest cross‑street) and a photo if possible.

types.description: General requests to the Boston Water and Sewer Commission, such as water main concerns or sewer line issues.
phrasings: Water pressure is low on my street.
Sewer backup in the alley behind my house.
We have a leak in the water main near the park.
Strange smell coming from the sewer line on my block.
types.crew_needs: Exact address or nearest intersection and a description of the problem.

types.description: Resident suspects or confirms a bed‑bug infestation in a dwelling.
phrasings: I think I have bed bugs in my apartment.
Found tiny bugs in the mattress, likely bed bugs.
There are bites and bugs in my bedroom.
Need pest control for a bed‑bug problem.
types.crew_needs: Exact address, unit number, and photos of the bugs or bites if possible.

types.description: Problems related to Boston Bikes, such as broken bike racks, unsafe bike lanes, or bike theft.
phrasings: The bike rack at the station is broken.
Bike lane on my street has a large pothole.
My bike was stolen from a city rack.
Need repair on the bike share dock.
types.crew_needs: Location (street, intersection, or station name) and a photo of the issue.

types.description: Requests for large‑scale recycling services (e.g., mattresses, bulk items) for big commercial or institutional buildings.
phrasings: We need a mattress pickup for the dormitory.
Our office has a pile of old furniture to recycle.
Can you arrange bulk recycling for the warehouse?
The school wants to schedule a large‑item recycling day.
types.crew_needs: Building name or address, list of items to be recycled, and preferred pickup date.

types.description: Requests inspection, repair, or upkeep of city bridges and overpasses.
phrasings: The bridge over the river has rusted railings.
Cracks appearing on the bridge deck.
Bridge lights are out at night.
Potholes on the bridge near the exit.
types.crew_needs: Bridge name or location and description of the issue.

types.description: Requests for a formal inspection of a building for safety or code compliance.
phrasings: I need a building inspection for my condo.
Can you schedule a safety check on my rental property?
Please inspect the new construction on my block.
We want a code compliance review for our storefront.
types.crew_needs: Property address, type of inspection requested, and any specific concerns.

types.description: Requests for collection of community‑event debris or bulk trash after a gathering.
phrasings: Need a pickup for the trash after the block party
Can you collect the leftover chairs and tables from the park event?
Bulk waste from the recent street fair needs removal
We have a pile of trash after the neighborhood clean‑up
types.crew_needs: Location of the debris and an estimate of the volume or number of items.

types.description: Requests for major, long‑range infrastructure projects such as park upgrades or new facilities.
phrasings: We need a new playground in our neighborhood park.
Can the city add a bike path along the river?
The community center needs a roof replacement.
Please consider building a splash pad at the park.
types.crew_needs: Specific site location, description of the improvement, and any community support documentation.

types.description: Reports of suspected carbon monoxide presence in a building or residence.
phrasings: My apartment smells like exhaust, think CO.
Carbon monoxide alarm went off in the office.
We feel dizzy, suspect carbon monoxide leak.
CO detector triggered in the basement.
types.crew_needs: Building address, unit number (if any), and time the alarm sounded.

types.description: Problems with storm‑water catch basins such as clogs, damage, or missing grates.
phrasings: The catch basin on my street is full of leaves.
Water is pooling because the storm drain is blocked.
The grate on the catch basin is broken.
Catch basin near the park is not draining.
types.crew_needs: Exact street location and a photo of the basin condition.

types.description: Requests for upkeep, repairs, or cleaning of city‑owned cemetery grounds.
phrasings: The grass in the cemetery is overgrown.
Broken headstone needs fixing at the cemetery.
We need trash cleared from the cemetery path.
The cemetery walkway is cracked and unsafe.
types.crew_needs: Cemetery name, specific area or plot, and photos of the problem.

types.description: Reports of persistent moisture problems or mold growth in residential units.
phrasings: There’s black mold on my bathroom wall.
My basement is constantly damp and smells musty.
We have a water‑logged ceiling in the living room.
Mold keeps returning after cleaning.
types.crew_needs: Unit address, location of dampness/mold, and photos if possible.

types.description: Reports of snow‑related problems that involve coordination between city and state agencies, such as major road blockages.
phrasings: The highway is still covered in snow after the storm.
State route 9 is blocked by a snow drift.
We need plowing on the bridge that connects to the state road.
Snow is making the interstate entrance unsafe.
types.crew_needs: Exact road or highway segment and any photos of the blockage.

types.description: Report abandoned or scattered construction debris that is creating a hazard or eyesore.
phrasings: There’s a pile of concrete blocks left on the sidewalk.
Construction trash is littering the street after a job finished.
I see broken drywall and wood debris in the alley.
Debris from a recent remodel is blocking the curb.
types.crew_needs: Location (street and nearest cross‑street), type of debris, and a photo if possible.

types.description: Complaints about contractor work, such as missed street cleaning or poor performance.
phrasings: The street cleaning crew didn’t show up this week.
Contractors left debris on the sidewalk after work.
The pothole repair was done poorly and is still unsafe.
Construction noise is exceeding allowed hours.
types.crew_needs: Location of the issue, contractor name (if known), and description of the problem.

types.description: Formal complaints about building contractors violating codes or permits.
phrasings: The contractor is building without a permit.
Work is being done after hours without approval.
The site is unsafe and the contractor ignored safety rules.
Construction debris is being dumped on the sidewalk.
types.crew_needs: Property address, contractor name (if known), description of violation, and any photos.

types.description: Resident reports that a sub‑meter or shared meter is reading incorrectly or needs to be installed/checked.
phrasings: My sub‑meter is showing the wrong usage.
Can someone check the shared meter for my building?
The sub‑meter reading looks off, need a fix.
We need a new sub‑meter installed in our unit.
types.crew_needs: Exact address of the unit, meter number (if known), and a photo of the meter display.

types.description: Report of blocked or unsafe emergency exit routes in a building.
phrasings: The fire exit door is locked.
Our building's egress stair is blocked by trash.
Emergency exit hallway is obstructed.
Can't open the exit door in my building.
types.crew_needs: Exact location (building address, floor, and stair/door number) and a photo of the blockage.

types.description: Reports of electrical problems such as power outages, faulty wiring, or no electricity.
phrasings: The street light on my corner is dead.
No power in my apartment since this morning.
There’s a sparking outlet in the hallway.
The traffic signal is flashing erratically.
types.crew_needs: Exact location (address or intersection) and description of the electrical issue.

types.description: Requests emptying of full litter baskets in parks, streets, or public plazas.
phrasings: The trash can on the corner is overflowing.
Litter basket at the park entrance is full and needs emptying.
The recycling bin near the bus stop is jammed with trash.
Our neighborhood basket is spilling over with garbage.
types.crew_needs: Exact basket location (street, park, or plaza) and any access restrictions.

types.description: Reports broken or malfunctioning park equipment such as swings, slides, benches, or sports gear.
phrasings: The swing set at the playground is rusted and unsafe.
A basketball hoop is broken at the field.
One of the park benches is cracked and wobbly.
The picnic table near the pond has a missing leg.
types.crew_needs: Specific park and equipment location, description of damage, and a photo.

types.description: Report a property that is continuing work or use beyond the time or scope allowed by its permit.
phrasings: Construction is still going on weeks after the permit expired.
The event is running longer than the approved time.
They’re still using the lot for storage after the permit ended.
The temporary fence is still up past the permit date.
types.crew_needs: Location, permit number if known, description of the over‑stay, and photos.

types.description: Reports a fire or smoke incident occurring inside a restaurant, cafe, or other food service venue.
phrasings: There's a fire in the kitchen of the diner down the street.
Smoke coming from the bakery on Main.
The restaurant next to me has a blaze in the cooking area.
Fire alarm went off at the coffee shop, looks like a fire.
types.crew_needs: Exact address of the establishment and any visible hazards (e.g., flames, smoke).

types.description: Requests for status updates or additional action on a previously filed inspection or enforcement case.
phrasings: What’s the update on my restaurant health inspection?
Can you check the status of my building complaint?
I need a follow‑up on the noise violation case.
Has the fire safety issue been resolved yet?
types.crew_needs: Original case number or reference and any new information the resident can provide.

types.description: Report a confirmed health violation at a food establishment, such as unsanitary conditions or foodborne illness risk.
phrasings: The restaurant on Main has a health code violation.
I saw food safety issues at the deli downtown.
There are unsanitary conditions at the bakery near me.
The cafe's kitchen looks dirty and could make people sick.
types.crew_needs: Exact address of the establishment, description of the problem, and photos of the unsanitary conditions.

types.description: Report a suspected health issue at a food venue that has not yet been verified by inspectors.
phrasings: I think the food at the deli made me sick.
Someone got food poisoning after eating at the taco stand.
The soup smelled off at the cafeteria.
I saw a customer get sick after eating at the bakery.
types.crew_needs: Venue name and location, description of the suspected issue, and any details (symptoms, time, etc.).

types.description: Feedback, compliments, or general comments directed to a specific city employee or department.
phrasings: Great job by the crew that cleared the trash last week!
I want to thank the inspector who helped with my permit.
The park staff were very helpful today.
Just wanted to leave a positive note for the street cleaning team.
types.crew_needs: Name of the employee (if known) or department and the comment text.

types.request_type: General Comments For a Program or Policy
types.description: Provides feedback, suggestions, or comments about city programs, policies, or services.
phrasings: I think the bike‑share program could use more stations downtown.
The street cleaning schedule should be earlier in the week.
Can the city add more recycling bins in the park?
I have a suggestion for improving the snow‑removal plan.
types.crew_needs: None; just the comment or suggestion text.

types.description: Requests for installation, repair, or adjustment of street lighting.
phrasings: The street light on my block is out.
Can you add a light at the dark intersection near the park?
The lamp post near my house flickers constantly.
We need better lighting on the bike path.
types.crew_needs: Location of the light (street, pole number if known), description of issue, and a photo.

types.description: Request new traffic signs, pavement markings, or other engineering improvements to improve safety or flow.
phrasings: We need a stop sign at the busy intersection near my school.
Can you add a bike lane on this street?
The crosswalk markings are faded at my corner.
Please install a speed‑limit sign on this road.
types.crew_needs: Exact location (street and cross‑streets), type of engineering improvement requested, and any supporting photos.

types.description: Removal of unwanted graffiti from public surfaces such as walls, sidewalks, or signs.
phrasings: Graffiti on the wall of the community center.
Someone painted tags on the sidewalk near my building.
Graffiti on the bus stop shelter.
Vandalized mural needs cleaning.
types.crew_needs: Exact location (street, landmark) and a photo of the graffiti.

types.description: Covers lawn care, grass trimming, leaf removal, and general ground upkeep in parks and public spaces.
phrasings: The grass in the park is overgrown and needs cutting.
Leaves are piling up around the playground area.
The field near the baseball diamonds is looking muddy and unkept.
We have weeds growing along the walking path.
types.crew_needs: Specific park or area name, exact spot needing work, and any access notes.

types.description: Reports heating problems in housing, either too hot or not enough heat.
phrasings: My apartment is freezing even though the thermostat is on.
The heat in my unit is blasting and making it unbearable.
There’s no heat in the hallway of my building.
The radiators are leaking and not providing enough warmth.
types.crew_needs: Full address, unit number, description of heat issue, and any photos of thermostats or radiators.

types.description: Report an unpermitted auto body or repair shop operating in a residential or non‑commercial area.
phrasings: Someone is running a car repair shop out of a house on my block.
There’s an illegal auto body shop in the backyard of a home.
A garage is operating without a permit on this street.
I see a car paint operation in a residential lot.
types.crew_needs: Exact address, description of the activities, and photos of the shop setup.

types.description: Reports trash, debris, or hazardous material left in public right‑of‑way without permission.
phrasings: Someone dumped a pile of trash on the sidewalk.
There’s a bag of garbage left in the alley behind the store.
I found a broken refrigerator abandoned on the street.
Random construction debris is sitting in the park.
types.crew_needs: Precise location (street, corner, or park), description of items, and a photo if possible.

types.description: Report a building or unit being occupied without the required permits or in violation of occupancy limits.
phrasings: A house on my block is being used as a hotel without a license.
There are too many people living in a single apartment.
The building is being used for a business without permission.
I think the basement is illegally rented out.
types.crew_needs: Address, description of the occupancy issue, and any supporting evidence (photos, number of occupants).

types.description: Report signs, flyers, or advertisements posted without permission on public property.
phrasings: There are flyers taped to the street pole illegally.
Someone posted a billboard without a permit on the sidewalk.
Unauthorized signs are covering the park bench.
A private advertisement is nailed to a city building.
types.crew_needs: Location (street, park, or building), description of the sign, and a photo.

types.description: Report a residence being used as an unpermitted rooming house or boarding home.
phrasings: A house on my street is operating as a rooming house without a permit.
There are many strangers staying at a single home here.
The building is being used as an illegal boarding house.
Multiple unrelated tenants are living in one apartment illegally.
types.crew_needs: Address, description of the suspected rooming house activity, and any photos or observations.

types.description: Report a vendor operating without a permit or in a prohibited location.
phrasings: There's a street vendor selling without a license on my block.
Someone is setting up a cart in the park illegally.
I see an unpermitted food stand on the sidewalk.
A vendor is operating on the sidewalk without permission.
types.crew_needs: Exact location (street and cross‑street), description of the vending activity, and a photo if safe to take.

types.description: Reports trash barrels or containers left in the wrong place or overflowing.
phrasings: Trash barrels are blocking the sidewalk on Elm
Someone left a garbage bin on the park path
Overflowing trash cans at the corner of 5th and Pine
Barrels stacked against the curb near the school
types.crew_needs: Exact location and, if possible, a photo showing the misplaced barrels.

types.description: Requests installation of brand‑new streetlights where none currently exist.
phrasings: We need a streetlight at the dead‑end of our street.
No lighting on the park trail, please add one.
Install a new lamp at the intersection of Oak and 5th.
The alley behind my building is dark, need a light.
types.crew_needs: Exact location (street, intersection, or area) and desired pole placement.

types.description: Reports that a product’s price is not displayed where required (e.g., at a market or vendor).
phrasings: The price tag is missing on the apples at the farmer’s market.
No price listed on the bottled water at the kiosk.
Can't see the cost of the pretzels on the stand.
Missing price label on the fresh fish display.
types.crew_needs: Vendor location (market name or street) and a photo of the item without a price.

types.description: Request to replace a missing or damaged street‑light knockdown (the metal base that holds the pole).
phrasings: The base for the street light is broken.
Missing knockdown on the light pole near my street.
Need a new knockdown for the street lamp.
The metal bracket for the light pole is gone.
types.crew_needs: Precise location (street and nearest cross‑street), and a photo of the damaged or missing knockdown.

types.description: Reports of lead hazards in housing, such as peeling paint or contaminated dust.
phrasings: Peeling paint in the old apartment may have lead.
Lead dust found in the basement of my rental.
Concern about lead in the water pipes of my house.
Kids playing with paint chips that could be lead.
types.crew_needs: Property address, unit number, and any visible evidence (photo).

types.description: Report that a public litter basket is broken, full, or missing.
phrasings: The trash can on the sidewalk is broken.
Litter basket at the park is overflowing.
Missing trash bin near the bus stop.
The public trash basket is tipped over.
types.crew_needs: Location (street, park name, or nearest landmark) and a photo of the basket's condition.

types.description: Report a maintenance issue on a private residence that may affect safety or code compliance.
phrasings: The porch railing on my house is broken.
My roof has missing shingles and is leaking.
The steps leading to my front door are cracked.
There’s a broken window on the second floor of my home.
types.crew_needs: Property address, specific maintenance problem, and photos showing the damage.

types.description: Residents reporting maintenance problems in their housing units.
phrasings: My apartment hallway light is out.
The faucet in my kitchen is leaking.
The building lobby has a broken door.
There’s a cracked window in my unit.
types.crew_needs: Unit number or building address, description of the problem, and a photo if possible.

types.description: Reports of large‑scale failures affecting water, gas, sewer, or other critical city systems.
phrasings: There’s a massive water main break on the highway.
Gas leak reported near the downtown plaza.
Sewer backup affecting multiple streets.
Citywide power outage in the East Boston area.
types.crew_needs: General area or street names, type of system affected, and any immediate safety hazards.

types.description: Requests removal of an old mattress for disposal.
phrasings: I need a mattress hauled away
Can you pick up a used mattress from my apartment?
Old mattress sitting in my hallway, need it removed
Schedule a mattress pickup for next week
types.crew_needs: Exact address and the mattress size (twin, queen, king).

types.description: Issues with building mechanical systems such as HVAC, elevators, or fire‑suppression equipment.
phrasings: The elevator in my building keeps stopping between floors.
Our HVAC is blowing hot air in the winter.
The fire alarm in the hallway is beeping nonstop.
The boiler in the basement is leaking water.
types.crew_needs: Building address, unit number (if applicable), and a description of the malfunction.

types.description: Resident reports of mouse or rodent activity inside homes or apartments.
phrasings: We’re seeing mice in our kitchen.
Rodents have been running through the hallway.
There are mouse droppings in the bedroom.
Mice are chewing wires in my apartment.
types.crew_needs: Unit number or building address and description of the infestation.

types.description: General complaints about snow removal, accumulation, or related hazards not covered by emergency requests.
phrasings: Snow still piled on the sidewalk after plowing.
Ice buildup on the curb is dangerous.
Snow drift blocking my driveway.
Uncleared snow on the bike lane.
types.crew_needs: Street and block, and description of the snow issue.

types.description: Reports that scheduled trash, recycling, yard waste, or bulk pickup was not collected.
phrasings: My trash wasn't picked up yesterday
Recycling bins are still out after collection day
Yard waste left on the curb after the pickup
Bulk item pickup missed this week
types.crew_needs: Street address, type of service missed, and the date it was supposed to be collected.

types.description: Reports that a traffic or street sign is missing, damaged, or needs replacement.
phrasings: The stop sign at the corner is gone.
Missing speed limit sign on Maple Ave.
The street name sign fell off the pole.
No yield sign where the road merges.
types.crew_needs: Exact location (intersection or mile marker) and type of sign needed.

types.description: Reports of mosquito activity that may pose a West Nile virus risk.
phrasings: Lots of mosquitoes around the playground.
Mosquitoes are biting everyone near the pond.
We think there’s a breeding site in the vacant lot.
Heavy mosquito presence on my block.
types.crew_needs: Location (street and nearest landmark) and any standing water sources observed.

types.description: Issues with city‑owned parking lots such as broken stalls, lighting, or illegal use.
phrasings: Parking spots are all taken by unauthorized cars.
The municipal lot has potholes.
Lights are out in the city parking garage.
The lot’s barrier gate is stuck.
types.crew_needs: Name or location of the municipal lot and specific problem details.

types.description: Removal of discarded needles or other hazardous sharps from streets or public areas.
phrasings: Found a used needle on the sidewalk near the park.
Needle on the bike path, please clean it up.
There are several syringes on the curb outside the school.
Sharp objects on the street near the bus stop.
types.crew_needs: Precise location (street and nearest cross‑street) and a photo if safe to take.

types.request_type: New Sign  Crosswalk or Pavement Marking
types.description: Requests for new or updated traffic signs, crosswalks, or pavement markings.
phrasings: Please add a crosswalk at the school entrance.
We need a stop sign at the dangerous intersection.
Can you repaint the bike lane markings on Main St?
Requesting a new speed‑limit sign near the park.
types.crew_needs: Exact location (street, intersection), type of sign or marking, and any supporting photos.

types.description: Requests planting of a new tree on public land or in a park.
phrasings: Can a new tree be planted on the vacant lot on my block?
We’d love a shade tree on the corner of Elm and 5th.
Please add a tree to the empty space near the playground.
Requesting a new maple tree for the community garden.
types.crew_needs: Exact planting location, preferred tree type (if any), and any soil or space constraints.

types.description: Reports about the condition, placement, or removal of newspaper distribution boxes.
phrasings: The news box on the corner is broken.
We need a new newspaper box near the library.
The box is overflowing with junk mail.
The newsstand box was stolen last night.
types.crew_needs: Exact street location and a photo showing the box’s condition.

types.description: Issues where gasoline price is missing or displayed incorrectly at a fuel station.
phrasings: The gas pump has no price listed.
Wrong price shown for diesel at the station.
Missing price tag on the gasoline dispenser.
Price on the pump is higher than advertised.
types.crew_needs: Gas station name or location and a photo of the pump display.

types.description: Reports of electrical problems in restaurants or other food‑service venues that affect health safety.
phrasings: The kitchen lights keep flickering during service.
Our ovens lost power and we can’t cook.
There’s a dead outlet in the prep area.
The restaurant’s breaker keeps tripping.
types.crew_needs: Address of the establishment, description of the electrical issue, and any visible damage photos.

types.description: Reports of flooding inside a restaurant or food‑service venue that affects health‑safety conditions.
phrasings: The kitchen floor is flooded after the storm.
Water is pooling around the prep area at the deli.
Our restaurant’s back room is under several inches of water.
There’s a leak in the dining area that’s causing a flood.
types.crew_needs: Exact address of the establishment, location of the flood, and a photo of the affected area.

types.description: Reports that a restaurant or food venue lacks sewer service or has a sewer backup.
phrasings: The diner has no sewer service today.
Sewer backup in the kitchen of the bakery.
Food truck's waste line is clogged.
No drainage in the restaurant restroom.
types.crew_needs: Establishment name or address and the time the issue started.

types.description: Reports that a restaurant or food venue lacks water service.
phrasings: The cafe has no running water today.
No water in the kitchen of the deli on Main.
Restaurant's water tap is dry.
Food truck can't get water for cleaning.
types.crew_needs: Establishment name or address and the time the outage began.

types.description: Resident reports loss of electric service at a home or apartment.
phrasings: No power in my apartment.
The electricity went out across the whole building.
My lights are out, no electricity.
We have an electric outage on our street.
types.crew_needs: Address, unit number (if applicable), and any recent outage notices.

types.description: Reports a lack of gas service to a residential unit, often after a move‑in or outage.
phrasings: My new apartment has no gas service.
No gas coming to the kitchen stove.
Gas line was shut off after the move.
Can't get gas for my water heater.
types.crew_needs: Exact address and account number if known.

types.description: Resident reports loss of water service at a home or apartment.
phrasings: No water coming out of any taps.
Our water stopped working this morning.
We have a water outage in the building.
Can't get any water in my house.
types.crew_needs: Address, unit number (if applicable), and any recent notices about water shut‑off.

types.description: Resident wants confirmation that a vehicle was not towed after a complaint or wants verification of a no‑tow request.
phrasings: Can you confirm my car wasn't towed?
I filed a no‑tow request, need status.
Did anyone check that my truck wasn't towed?
Please verify my vehicle is still here.
types.crew_needs: License plate number, exact location where the vehicle is parked, and date/time of the original complaint.

types.description: General notifications about city‑wide service disruptions like water main breaks, sewer overflows, or fire alerts.
phrasings: I heard there's a water main break nearby.
Can you confirm a sewer overflow in my area?
Is there a fire alert for my neighborhood?
Need info on the recent water shutoff.
types.crew_needs: Neighborhood or street name and the type of notification the resident wants confirmed.

types.description: Reports of occupants using a property without a current Certificate of Occupancy or Inspection.
phrasings: People are living in a building that looks abandoned.
There's an illegal tenant in a vacant storefront.
A house is being used without any permits.
Unpermitted occupants in the basement unit.
types.crew_needs: Property address and any visible signage or documentation indicating lack of permits.

types.description: Reports housing units that exceed legal occupancy limits.
phrasings: There are too many people living in that apartment.
The house on my street has way more tenants than allowed.
Overcrowded living conditions in the building next door.
Multiple families are sharing one small unit.
types.crew_needs: Address of the dwelling and number of occupants observed.

types.description: Resident reports a dumpster that is overflowing, dirty, or not being maintained properly.
phrasings: The dumpster on my block is overflowing.
Trash is spilling out of the dumpster behind my building.
The dumpster hasn't been emptied in weeks.
Garbage is piling up around the dumpster.
types.crew_needs: Exact address or location of the dumpster and a photo showing the condition.

types.description: Reports graffiti or vandalism on public works property, including walls, signs, and structures.
phrasings: There’s graffiti on the side of the water tower.
Someone painted tags on the street sign near my block.
The metal fence by the park has spray‑paint vandalism.
Graffiti on the public restroom door needs removal.
types.crew_needs: Exact location, description of graffiti, and a clear photo.

types.description: Requests for enhancements, repairs, or new amenities in city parks.
phrasings: Please add more benches at the playground.
We need a new basketball hoop in the park.
Can the walking path be resurfaced?
Install a water fountain near the picnic area.
types.crew_needs: Park name, specific improvement desired, and any location details within the park.

types.description: Reports illegal, unsafe, or improperly parked vehicles.
phrasings: Car parked on a fire hydrant
Someone double‑parked in front of my building
Bike blocking the curb on my street
Truck parked in a no‑parking zone
types.crew_needs: Exact location (street name and nearest cross‑street) and a photo of the offending vehicle.

types.description: Reports malfunctioning, broken, or unreadable parking meters.
